issues.issue: The user's balance-sheet-basis rule (2026-10-27) takes cash-basis governmental lines from the governmental funds statement when its totals equal the government-wide figures. They do here: 1,065,870 / 3,406 / 1,062,465. The extraction used the combined government-wide Total column instead. Its amounts are correct as printed, but governmental Unassigned 841,756 is merged with proprietary 301,806 as Unrestricted 1,143,562.

The report's own label says this line is mostly or partly homestead credits (category Homestead Exemption), but no breakdown is printed, so other taxes with a review note is defensible. The same applies to detail[1] (28,966) and detail[8] (799).
